no_2026_access.note: the arm table is filtered upstream; 2026 is never loaded

independent_replay_state_and_labels.method: state recomputed on an array HARD-TRUNCATED at the observation bar; labels recomputed on an array that BEGINS at observation bar + 1; entry price recovered from the accepted population, not from the panel

forward_labels_strictly_after_observatio.evidence: derived from the replay: 8,671 observation states matched a recomputation whose label slice starts at j+1, so no forward label can contain the observation bar or anything before it
forward_labels_strictly_after_observatio.structural: suffix arrays in engine.forward_at are sliced [j+1 : unc_i+1]; there is no array spanning j

natural_exit_reconciles_from_every_obser.note: exit_now + continuation == natural return, on the mark basis and both fill bases

barrier_collisions_adverse_with_optimist.resolution: same-bar collisions resolved ADVERSE for economic reporting; every race table carries the optimistic bound as *_optimistic and the unresolved share

placebo_cannot_choose_exit_with_future_i.lifetime_uniform: index-uniform over [confirm, stop-live terminal); outcome-blind, but its SUPPORT depends on the realised lifetime -- a benchmark, never a rule
placebo_cannot_choose_exit_with_future_i.length_blind: offset drawn from the frozen dense grid; support does not depend on the realised lifetime, so it is causally implementable
placebo_cannot_choose_exit_with_future_i.finding: the gap between the two IS the measure of how much of a random exit's apparent edge is knowledge of the trade's length

repeated_observations_not_treated_as_ind.stability_unit: TRADE_FIRST -- one observation per trade per bucket (SPEC D8); the decision gate's year and direction conditions read only that unit

contract_checker.note_on_authorship: contract-checker is read-only (Read/Grep/Glob) and cannot write this file; the audit was performed by the agent and the record transcribed verbatim by the main session, with the REMEDIATED blocks added after the fixes were applied and the pipeline re-run.

findings.summary: extended_horizon.parquet (#13) had no CSV mirror; the manifest requires CSV mirrors for #1, #3-#13, #15. Only extended_horizon_summary.csv existed.
findings.remediation: analysis/phases.py now writes results/extended_horizon.csv alongside the parquet; the mirror is produced by the pipeline, not by hand.

findings.summary: decision_gate.parquet was wide (one row per region, c1_*..c8_* columns) rather than the manifest's literal long form 'condition, value, threshold, passed'. Substance (8 conditions x 220 regions) was present; shape differed.
findings.remediation: analysis/gate.py additionally emits results/decision_gate_conditions.parquet/.csv in the exact long form (region, axis, n_obs, n_unique_trades, condition, metric, value, threshold, operator, passed). The wide table is retained because the REPORT cites per-region context that the long form drops.

findings.summary: buckets.py::slices() skips a zero-row YEAR/SIDE slice, so an empty partition would have been dropped silently rather than surfaced. Moot in this run (all 10 partitions non-empty) but not structurally enforced.
findings.remediation: validate.py gains gate 'domain_completeness_partitions_and_offsets', which asserts the 10-cell year x side grid against an explicit expected set and asserts all 40 dense offsets are present with alive > 0. Completeness is now asserted, not inferred.

findings.summary: validation_report.json gate 'auditors_clean' read present:false for both auditors because it was written before the audits ran.
findings.remediation: validate.py re-run after both audit status files landed; the gate is now satisfied from the real files.
